_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for NZIHL/NZWIHL player-name corrections used across every broadcast-asset repo (roster PDFs, player photo warehouse, live overlays). Edit ONLY this file -- consumers fetch it at runtime/scrape-time and fall back to a small hardcoded snapshot if the fetch fails, so a network hiccup never breaks an on-air graphic. See matchavez/hockey's nzihl_player_name_overrides memory for the full history of why each entry exists.

team_jersey_overrides.note: Canterbury Inferno -- esportsdesk stores her as 'Shattock (Niskakoski)', a maiden-name parenthetical baked into the source title attribute.

parenthetical_strips.note: Strip Reagyn Shattock's maiden-name parenthetical from any raw scraped text before parsing (goal/assist/penalty rows, title attributes, etc.).
